record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare AURORA_VEIL: Alolan Vulpix (1 star) and Alolan Ninetales (2 stars); both have maxPP 80, range 2 and no declared passive. The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count (table index).
record.summary: Needs no target. Every on-board unit of the caster's team (the caster included, anywhere on the board) gains a shield of raw 5/10/20/50 (by caster stars; AP-scaled, crit only with ability crit) and Rune Protect for a flat 1000 ms, which also clears its negative-status cooldowns and makes status triggers that test runeProtect do nothing while it lasts.

targeting.who: all allies on the board (team equality with the caster), the caster included; no range or position limit
targeting.note: requiresTarget is false, so process runs with target null. Dead units are not on the board; an ally with hp 0 still present would get no shield (addShield requires hp > 0) but would receive the Rune Protect call.

geometry.shape: whole team (every cell of the board is scanned)

effects.target: each ally on the board, caster included
effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied per ally: Big Eater Belt on that ally x1.25 rounded down (PokemonEntity.addShield); then x(1 + AP/100) with AP of the caster (apBoost 1), x critPower if the cast crit, x0.5 if the receiving ally is enraged, rounded (PokemonState.addShield); shield = max(0, shield + value). Nothing is added to an ally with hp 0.
effects.resolution: requested (table) -> belt-adjusted -> applied (after AP, crit, enraged, rounding) -> shield added. The belt and enraged state depend on each receiving ally, not on the caster, so the applied amount can differ between allies. No timer or removal here; later damage consumes the shield.

effects.target: each ally on the board, caster included
effects.scaling: none: the duration is the literal 1000 and is not changed by AP, crit or duration reductions (triggerRuneProtect applies none). The timer is only replaced if longer than the ally's remaining Rune Protect.
effects.resolution: triggerRuneProtect sets runeProtect, calls clearNegativeStatus (cooldowns of the listed negative statuses zeroed; the boolean flags are reset by the status update), and the timer runs in the status update. While it is set, status triggers that guard on runeProtect (e.g. silence, shown) are ignored. Applied after the shield for each ally.

statusEffects.effect: Rune Protect 1000 ms on each ally, with negative-status cooldowns cleared at application

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; 20 and 50 are not reached at the bare factory star counts of these units. Rune Protect duration does not depend on stars.

record.positionalConditions: None: allies anywhere on the board are affected. Needs no enemy in range, because requiresTarget is false.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Shields stack additively with existing shields; Rune Protect timer only extends if longer.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: shield 5/10 (1/2 stars) and Rune Protect 1000 ms. Requested = raw; applied shield = raw [x1.25 down for a Big Eater Belt holder] x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor] [x0.5 if the receiver is enraged], rounded, per ally. Rune Protect is 1000 ms exactly. The cleansing happens inside triggerRuneProtect.
